id: title:EDsCODE:heartbeat and stop cancelled view translations

observations.behavior: Adds a check for cancellation and job status before processing each batch of views; raises immediately if cancelled or not running.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the workflow from continuing to record failed or stale results after cancellation. It also avoids unnecessary database updates on an already-cancelled job.

observations.behavior: Checks that the parent job is still RUNNING before updating individual result rows, even when compiling one view at a time.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures no PENDING results are transitioned to STALE/FAILED once the overall compilation has been requested to stop, preserving atomicity with respect to cancellation requests.

observations.behavior: Tests that the compiled SQL was never executed and no results were recorded when the activity is cancelled mid-flight.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates end-to-end behavior under cancellation, including heartbeat checks and early exit without side effects.

observations.limitations: Only this chunk is supplied; broader context around other managed warehouse activities and complete test coverage is unavailable. No score can account for unshown hunks.

review.limitations: Only this chunk is supplied; broader context around other managed warehouse activities and complete test coverage is unavailable. No score can account for unshown hunks.
review.reason: The change adds bounded, localized reliability improvements: it introduces explicit cancellation handling, status guards against recording partial results, and tests these behaviors. This fits tier 2 (substantive, bounded correctness improvement) rather than tier 3, which would require systemic or cross-component risk reduction demonstrated across multiple workflows.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s managed warehouse feature where HogQL queries are translated into Trino SQL via Temporal workflow. The changes reduce wasted work and prevent inconsistent state after user-initiated cancellations.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies only on provided chunk; full implementation and production configuration not available.
